answer_1.quote: This work consists of two main objectives: (1) effectively informing summarization models of the source document's structure, and (2) presenting a new summarization task that produces hierarchically organized question-summary pairs to facilitate information consumption.
answer_1.outputs: hierarchically organized question-summary pairs, full document summaries

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE for summarization evaluation and additionally report BLEU up to 4-gram for evaluating the generated questions.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is conducted on QSGen-Hier, for five models with the highest automatic scores, to help understand how well the generated hierarchies are structured. We hire three judges who have extensive experience in summarization annotation and evaluation tasks to assess 50 groups of question-summary hierarchies.
answer_4.guideline: First, we ask evaluators to correct each generated hierarchy by rearranging the QS pairs so that each pair is attached to the parent that forms the best follow-up relation in steps. Second, for each QS pair, we ask them to determine if the question can be answered by the summary.
